executive_summary: The infrastructure shows signs of underutilization and potential single points of failure, particularly with the missing network interfaces and routes on two servers. Immediate action is recommended to mitigate risks.

predicted_failures.description: The server is underutilized and has multiple network interfaces, which could indicate hardware issues or misconfiguration.

root_causes.description: The server TAP-5CD52899ZH is the sole active node for HTTP services, creating a single point of failure.

preventive_measures.action: Implement active-active High Availability for HTTP services.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will ensure that the service remains available even if one server fails.
